expected_outcome.rule: Preserve uncertainty about the exact v5 omitted bool replacement. OUTCOME 0 identifies false, -1 identifies na, 1 identifies true. Capture any refusal exactly.

claim_under_test: Omitted bool replacement in legacy nz is false. Conditional prediction: successful OUTCOME=0 on every historical row.
record: At least 100 historical OUTCOME rows, unchanged defaults and original source; or exact compile/runtime diagnostic with phase, code if visible, and text.
adjudication: NA is tested before the ternary, so 0 cannot silently conflate false and na. This v5 probe does not independently settle v4.
